_note: The analyst's suggestion chips, one list per route kind. Edited only through Stewart's decisions, shown to him as a table in chat first. tools/build_app_data.py reads this file and fails the build if a key is missing or has fewer than three strings. Every figure quoted in a chip was re-derived from the data on 11 September 2026; if a research pass moves a count, the chip that quotes it has to move with it.
